text:
If the plant arrived damaged (snapped main stem, exposed roots, cracked pot, or dead or severely wilted), you need to report it within **48 hours** of delivery, with photos of the plant and the box. We'll then send a free replacement on the next plant shipping day, or refund you.

After 48 hours, the issue goes through the Plant Care Guarantee instead. You have **30 days** from delivery (**90 days** for Leafy Plus members) to make a claim from "My Orders" with at least two photos (whole plant plus a close-up). A Plant Care Specialist reviews it within 2 business days.
